title: CHN-* items
summary: Bicycle chains covering 8-speed to 11-speed specifications with warehouse stock-on-hand levels as of 26 October 2026.
body:
The `CHN-*` item family encompasses drive chains used across Northbridge Cycles drivetrain assemblies. As of 09:00 GMT on 26 October 2026, inventory covers four distinct speed specifications across the Manchester and Leeds stores. Stock balances are recorded in the central [[data-stock-on-hand|stock register]].

## Stock on hand

Inventory positions as of 09:00 on 26 October 2026 across stores are:

| Item code | Location | On hand | Allocated | On order |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CHN-8S | WH-MAN-STR | 8 | 2 | 10 |
| CHN-9S | WH-MAN-STR | 15 | 1 | 0 |
| CHN-9S | WH-LDS-STR | 9 | 0 | 0 |
| CHN-10S | WH-MAN-STR | 148 | 6 | 0 |
| CHN-11S | WH-MAN-STR | 595 | 34 | 0 |

At 09:00 on 26 October 2026, stock for chain CHN-8S at WH-MAN-STR was 8 on hand, 2 allocated, and 10 on order [^r1]. At the same time, stock for chain CHN-9S was 15 on hand, 1 allocated, and 0 on order at WH-MAN-STR, alongside 9 on hand, 0 allocated, and 0 on order at WH-LDS-STR [^r2]. Chain CHN-10S at WH-MAN-STR stood at 148 on hand, 6 allocated, and 0 on order [^r3]. Chain CHN-11S at WH-MAN-STR held 595 on hand, 34 allocated, and 0 on order [^r4].
